description: The V=4 blocks-plus-abelian repair clears the vertex bound but fails D1-c's own bar-ray stipulation: 0 of 128 bar-symmetric quivers give (4,3) on sigma-related rays, while all 128 give it on arbitrary rays.

vertex_set.sigma_meaning: bar = partition conjugation on H_3 blocks; abelian fixed

result.verdict: the V=4 repair CLEARS the vertex bound and FAILS D1-c's bar-ray stipulation

acyclicity.statement: bar-symmetry forbids arrows between conjugate Wedderburn blocks in any acyclic quiver, since sigma-invariance turns 0->2 into a 2-cycle with 2->0

relation_to_the_landed_Lean.theorem: QuiverMirrorAutomorphismExcluded (sorry-free): any count-invariant mirror implementation forces every readable pair amphichiral, so (4,3) is unreachable
relation_to_the_landed_Lean.what_is_new_here: not the statement but that it is checked on THE SPECIFIC vertex set the repair proposes — the repair was designed to clear a DIFFERENT bound (the vertex count) and does, so it was not obvious the same obstruction would survive

scope.potential: W = 0; a potential can only cut further
scope.closes: the blocks-plus-abelian repair UNDER D1-c's own bar-ray stipulation — not D1-c the route, and not every (Q,W)
scope.per_ray_equality_is: measured here; the cited Lean theorem proves the general statement
